purpose: Validate design-based ecological prevalence inference from the protected uniform-exploration subset of the frozen guarded portfolio, without changing V6/V7/V8 scientific settings.

estimands.primary: realized finite-population event prevalence K/N in each generated world
estimands.secondary: nominal generating prevalence only for grouping/interpretation

estimators.naive_full_selected: sample mean over all guarded-selected windows; intentionally treats targeted sample as if representative
estimators.protected_exploration: sample mean over the initial simple-random exploration draw only; targeted spillover is excluded from this reference subset

intervals.naive_full_selected: 95% Wilson binomial interval used only as a misspecified diagnostic comparator
intervals.protected_exploration: 95% exact equal-tailed hypergeometric confidence set for the finite-population success count K, inverted from the SRS-without-replacement sampling distribution

pre_registered_interpretation.design_claim: The protected exploration subset is the probability-sample reference design; inference claims are attached to this subset, not to the targeted sample as a whole.
pre_registered_interpretation.coverage_claim: The exact hypergeometric interval is expected to meet or exceed nominal 95% finite-population coverage by construction; simulation verifies the implementation across the frozen regime grid.
pre_registered_interpretation.naive_claim: Any bias or undercoverage from the full targeted sample is a consequence of treating preferentially selected observations as representative and is retained rather than corrected post hoc.
pre_registered_interpretation.no_tuning: After the first V9 result is inspected, the regime grid, estimators, confidence level and frozen 50/10/40 allocation are not changed under V9.

v7_independence: V9 imports no V7 world, seed, pixels, traces, report or gate and cannot rescue a failing V7 validation.
